script: Can you describe your current process for generating and submitting EU CSRD sustainability reports, and what tools or systems do you use to support this task?

How do you currently handle data mapping between your existing ERP system and the EU CSRD reporting requirements, and are there any workarounds you've developed due to complexity or lack of resources?
What would be a realistic threshold for you to consider investing in a compliance-automation SaaS solution that could simplify this process, such as an annual payment amount or percentage of revenue?
interview_answers:
To be honest, I'm not really sure how our company generates and submits the EU CSRD sustainability report. We're a manufacturing company, but we've never had any issues with reporting requirements like that before. I think it's something new for us.

As far as I know, we just have to collect some data from various parts of the business, like energy consumption, waste production, and stuff like that, and then probably use our ERP system to get those numbers right. After that, we'd need to figure out what exactly needs to be reported and how to format it.

I'm not really sure if we have any specific tools or systems for this task. We do use our ERP system for daily operations, but I don't think it's set up for reporting requirements like CSRD. Maybe we'll need something new? 

We usually get some guidance from our external auditors on what needs to be reported and how to report it, but I'm not really sure if that's the right way to do things. Have you worked with companies that have these kinds of reporting requirements before? How did you guys handle it?

To be honest, I haven't really thought about that too much. We just kind of... figure it out as we go, I guess. Our external auditors usually provide us with some guidance on what data needs to be reported and how to report it.

I think we've used our ERP system's built-in reporting features to try and extract the necessary data, but it's not always straightforward. Sometimes we have to use custom formulas or reports to get the information we need. It's been a bit of a challenge, to be honest.

We haven't really developed any workarounds because, well, we just don't know what we're doing yet! (laughs) But seriously, I think we've relied on our auditors and consultants to help us navigate this process so far. We'll probably need some more specialized tools or expertise if we want to get it right.

I'm not sure how common this is, but in our industry, we often have to adapt to changing regulations and reporting requirements. It's just part of doing business, I suppose. But with the EU CSRD, it feels like a new ball game altogether.

Honestly, I'm not sure how much we'd need to invest to make it worth our while. We're a mid-sized company, and we don't have a huge budget for new systems or software.

I think what would really help us is if the solution could be affordable and make sense financially. If it was something like 1-2% of our annual revenue, that might be manageable. But I'm not sure if that's even realistic.

We've had some experience with customizing our ERP system to meet our specific needs, so I think we'd want a solution that could integrate well with what we already have. If the cost was too high, it might just be easier for us to stick with what we know and figure things out ourselves... but like I said, that's not really an option right now.

I'm also concerned about whether or not any solution would really make a significant impact on our sustainability reporting process. We've been managing our operations without too much trouble so far, so if the solution was just going to simplify things slightly, it might not be worth the investment. But if it could really help us streamline our reporting and get everything right, then that's a different story...

report.title: A Compliance-Automation SaaS for Mid-Sized German Manufacturers
report.executive_summary: Mid-sized German manufacturers face challenges in meeting EU CSRD sustainability-reporting requirements due to data integration challenges and regulatory complexities. A compliance-automation SaaS can help streamline reporting processes, reducing costs and complexity. The proposed solution maps EU CSRD requirements onto existing ERP data, drafting annual disclosures. Pricing is a key consideration, with affordability and integration being major pain points.

Behavioral simulations suggest that affordability and integration are key factors influencing purchasing decisions.
